nodes.label:
Define six compositional tasks
single/two object · counting · color
position · color attribute binding

Build template vocabularies
80 MS-COCO object classes
10 generation colors · 3 counts · 4 positions

Sample 100 prompts per task
fill task-specific templates uniformly
remove duplicates → 553 prompts total

Run each text-to-image model
generate 4 images for every prompt
preserve prompt metadata for verification

Detect and segment objects
COCO Mask2Former threshold 0.3
use 0.9 only for counting

Verify object requirements
presence and exact count
centroid geometry for relative position

Verify color and attribute binding
crop by box · mask background gray
zero-shot CLIP ViT-L/14 over candidate colors

Assign binary correctness per image
pass only when every requested element
property and relation is correct

Average the four generations
report each of the six task scores
average task scores for overall GenEval

Validate against human judgment
6,000 annotations on 1,200 images
83% agreement · 88% inter-annotator · 91% unanimous
